header.title: Open CAD Studio
header.desc: A full-featured 2D + 3D CAD application built in Rust with GPU-accelerated rendering. Native DWG & DXF read and write, paper space, ACIS solids, dimensions, layouts. An open source community project by Hakan Seven, recognized and promoted by the OpenAEC Foundation.

what.title: What is Open CAD Studio?
what.desc: Open CAD Studio is an independent open-source CAD project filling a major gap in AEC tooling: a modern, performant, native DWG/DXF-compatible CAD application that doesn't depend on Autodesk, Bricsys or other commercial vendors. Entirely written in Rust, with GPU-accelerated rendering via wgpu and an interactive UI in iced.
what.desc2: The OpenAEC Foundation views Open CAD Studio as a natural addition to the ecosystem. The project isn't developed by us, but it fits our mission: promoting open source software for the entire AEC chain. We link to it actively and encourage collaboration.
what.license: License: GPL-3.0 (note: different from our own LGPL-3.0 tools, which is more permissive for library use).

formats.title: File formats — native DWG & DXF
formats.desc: Perhaps the most important feature: Open CAD Studio reads and writes DWG and DXF natively, across all versions from R13 through R2018. No converters, no workarounds, no Autodesk libraries.

dwg.title: DWG (R13–R2018)
dwg.desc: Native reading and writing of DWG files — the de-facto industry-standard format. Without third-party library licenses.

dxf.title: DXF (R13–R2018)
dxf.desc: Full DXF read/write including modern versions. Compatible with AutoCAD, BricsCAD, LibreCAD and any CAD application that supports DXF.

stl.title: STL / STEP / OBJ
stl.desc: Export to STL and STEP AP203 for 3D printing and CAM. OBJ import for 3D models from other sources.

pdf.title: PDF plot
pdf.desc: Plot layouts directly to PDF — with correct paper sizes read from embedded PlotSettings.

wblock.title: WBLOCK
wblock.desc: Write selected entities or a block to an external file for reuse.

xref.title: XREF
xref.desc: External references (xrefs) attach, reload and auto-resolve — just like AutoCAD.

drafting.title: 2D drafting
drafting.desc: Complete 2D drafting package with all the commands you'd expect from a professional CAD application:

modify.title: Modify
modify.desc: OFFSET, TRIM, EXTEND, FILLET, BREAK, STRETCH, LENGTHEN — works on lines, arcs, ellipses, polylines and splines

hatch.title: Hatch
hatch.desc: HATCH and HATCHEDIT with pattern, scale and angle editing.

mass.title: Properties
mass.desc: MASSPROP — area, perimeter and centroid of selected entities.

text.title: Text editing
text.desc: DDEDIT — double-click to edit text. MTEXT, TEXT, DTEXT with font browser.

modeling.title: 3D modelling
modeling.desc: Full 3D modelling capabilities with ACIS solids tessellation:

extrude.title: Extrude & revolve
extrude.desc: Profile-based solids: EXTRUDE for linear extrusion and REVOLVE for rotation about an axis.

loft.title: Loft & sweep
loft.desc: LOFT between multiple profiles, SWEEP along any path.

acis.title: ACIS tessellation
acis.desc: Renders 3DSOLID, REGION and BODY entities — solids from DWG/DXF are displayed correctly.

gpu.title: GPU-accelerated
gpu.desc: wgpu-based rendering. Smooth interaction with large models, even with many solids at once.

annotations.title: Annotations & dimensions
annotations.desc: Full dimensioning, GD&T, leaders, tables and mlines — all with style managers and correct DIMSTYLE behaviour (DIMASZ, DIMSCALE, DIMEXO, DIMEXE, …).

layouts.title: Multi-tab layout
layouts.desc: Model space + unlimited paper space tabs. Camera position and zoom saved per layout.

viewports.title: Viewport projection
viewports.desc: Model content correctly projected into paper-space viewport rectangles. Double-click for inline MSPACE overlay.

styles.title: Plot styles
styles.desc: PLOTSTYLEPANEL and STYLESMANAGER — CTB/STB plot style table editor.

print.title: PRINT
print.desc: Send layouts directly to the system printer with correct paper sizes from embedded PlotSettings.

tech.title: Technology
tech.desc: Entirely written in Rust — memory-safe, fast, compiles to Windows, macOS and Linux. UI via iced, GPU rendering via wgpu. Native DWG/DXF without vendor lock-in.

download.title: Download v2026.37
download.desc: Released June 2026. Three native binaries — Windows, macOS (Apple Silicon) and Linux (AppImage). Pick the one for your platform and you're up and running in seconds.
